title: An etale scheme map to an algebraic space is surjective etale onto an open image
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $U$ be an $S$-scheme, within the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $f:h_U\to X$ be a representable etale morphism; representability, etaleness and surjectivity are tested on all scheme base changes as in [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Then there is an algebraic space $X_f$ over $S$, identified with a subfunctor of $X$, whose inclusion $j:X_f\hookrightarrow X$ is representable and becomes an open immersion on every scheme base change [def-weil-open-immersion], and a factorization $f=j\circ f_f$ with $f_f:h_U\to X_f$ representable, surjective and etale. The underlying set $|X_f|\subseteq |X|$ is exactly the image of $|U|\to |X|$. Here $|X|$ is the set of field-valued point classes: maps $\operatorname{Spec}K\to X$ for fields $K$, identified if they agree over a common field extension; $|X_f|$ consists of classes factoring through $X_f$.

source.place: Tag 06NF, lemma-etale-image-open, first assertion and its factorization (lines 536-555); the quotient-presentation clause is not needed here.

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-space-etale-open-image] with the algebraic space $E=h_U$, the target $F=X$, and the representable etale map $q=f$. Its conclusion supplies an open subspace $X_f\subseteq X$ whose underlying set is exactly the point image of $|h_U|\to|X|$, an inclusion $j:X_f\hookrightarrow X$ that is representable by open immersions, and a factorization $h_U\to X_f\to X$ whose first map $f_f$ is representable, surjective and etale. Here $|h_U|$ is the set of field-valued point classes of $h_U$, which is the meaning of $|U|$ under the convention fixed in the item statement (equivalently the underlying set of the scheme $U$, a point $u$ corresponding to $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(u)\to U$). This is precisely the asserted $X_f$, inclusion $j$, and factorization $f=j\circ f_f$.

lean.statement: theorem etaleSchemeMap_openImage {S : Scheme.{u}} (X : AlgebraicSpace S) (U : Over S) (f : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X.obj.obj) (hf : IsRepresentable f) (he : IsEtale f) : ∃ (Xf : AlgebraicSpace S) (j : Xf ⟶ X) (ff : yoneda.obj U ⟶ Xf.obj.obj), (∀ T : (Over S)ᵒᵖ, Function.Injective (j.hom.hom.app T)) ∧ IsRepresentableWith (fun _ _ p ↦ IsOpenImmersion p.left) j.hom.hom ∧ ff ≫ j.hom.hom = f ∧ IsRepresentable ff ∧ IsSurjective ff ∧ IsEtale ff ∧ ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] (s : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ S) (x : X.obj.obj.obj (op (Over.mk s))), (∃ y : Xf.obj.obj.obj (op (Over.mk s)), j.hom.hom.app _ y = x) ↔ ∃ (L : Type u) (_ : Field L) (e : K →+* L) (y : Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e) ≫ s) ⟶ U), f.app _ y = X.obj.obj.map (Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom e)) rfl).op x
